title: Sign your clinic up
intro: Start with your clinic's name and your e-mail. You will be the clinic's admin, and the 30-day trial starts when you confirm the address.
enterBoth: Enter your e-mail and the clinic name.
invalid: Check the e-mail address and the clinic name.
tooMany: Too many sign-ups. Try again later.
checkEmail: Check your e-mail. If the address can be used, a link to confirm it is on its way.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
verified: Your e-mail is confirmed. We have sent you an invitation to set up the clinic admin account.
invalidLink: This link no longer works. Sign up again.
incompleteLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link in your e-mail again.
setupIntro: Each step can be done now or later. You can come back to this list at any time.
banner: Your clinic's setup is not finished.
